reply_text: Gideon asked which Moss digest lists Orlavine at 55 seats. I found one in the brain: "Moss: Strategic digest 9/30," dated Wednesday, Sep 30, 2026. It is addressed to Ruth Calloway, and I can't confirm Gideon can see it. I posted that in #strategic-random, plus a correction.
